component.name: Lhuna
component.summary: Chiptunes player with per-voice oscilloscope and chips dashboards

description.p: Desktop player of chiptunes and tracker music based on ZXTune core: AY/YM, SID, SNES SPC, VGM, NES, Game Boy, PSF and hundreds of other formats, including files inside archives.

ul.li: Per-voice oscilloscope with correlation trigger and chips dashboards
Live emulation settings of the playing tune's chips, SID filter presets with cutoff curve
Playlists compatible with the Android app (XSPF, M3U8)
